method.surf_score: 100 × size × period × direction × wind × tide; each factor 0–1 (see rule per spot)
method.swell_inputs: forecast at the driver buoy: total Hs and mean direction (best_match), peak period (ecmwf_wam025)

wind.text: 1 when ≤ calm; loses k per km/h above calm, k blends from offshore to onshore by (1 + cos θ)/2

method.tide: normalised level over the 10-day prediction window (0 lowest, 1 highest); floor outside the preferred band
method.daylight: civil dawn to dusk at each spot
method.window: ≥ 2 consecutive daylight hours at ≥ 40 (C or better); window score = mean of its best 3 hours
method.paddle_score: 100 × wind × gust × wave; each 1 at or under the 'full' threshold, 0 at 'zero'

jordan.name: Jordan River
notes: Swell must wrap ~70 km down Juan de Fuca Strait, so only a long-period W swell reaching Neah Bay at 2.5 m+ makes it here; S swell is blocked by the Olympic Peninsula (assumption, community surf guides).
Faces SSW: offshore is a N–NE wind (outflow), onshore is the usual SW–W sea breeze.
Reef/cobble point said to work best low to mid tide (surf-guide lore, unverified).

sombrio.name: Sombrio Beach
notes: Further out the strait than Jordan River, so it needs less swell (assumption).
Faces SSW–SW: offshore is NE.
Point/reef breaks favour low to mid tide (surf-guide lore, unverified).

chesterman.name: Chesterman Beach
notes: Open Pacific beach: takes S to NW swell. La Perouse Bank is 35 km offshore, so beach size is roughly 60–90 % of the buoy (assumption).
Faces WSW: offshore is an ENE wind, usually early morning.
Beach break, works on most tides; mid tide preferred (surf-guide lore, unverified).

cox.name: Cox Bay
notes: The most exposed Tofino beach: picks up the most swell and maxes out first (assumption).
Faces SW: offshore is a NE wind.
Works on all tides; tide is not scored here.

longbeach.name: Long Beach (Incinerator Rock)
notes: Long open beach in Pacific Rim National Park Reserve; similar exposure to Cox Bay (assumption).
Faces SW: offshore is a NE wind.
Mid tide preferred (surf-guide lore, unverified).

victoria_waterfront.name: Victoria waterfront (Gonzales–Clover Point)
notes: Exposed to the strait: waves come from the Juan de Fuca model cell offshore.
Strong tidal currents off Clover Point and Trial Island; tide shown, not scored.

victoria_harbour.name: Inner Harbour & Gorge
notes: Sheltered: wind only. Watch harbour traffic and floatplanes.

english_bay.name: English Bay & Kitsilano
notes: Exposed to westerlies off the Strait of Georgia; English Bay buoy checks the wave forecast.

false_creek.name: False Creek & Deep Cove
notes: Sheltered: wind only. Observed wind for the backtest is Vancouver Airport (exposed, so conservative).

46087.name: Neah Bay
46087.note: Mouth of Juan de Fuca Strait. The usual swell proxy for Jordan River and Sombrio.

46206.name: La Perouse Bank
46206.note: Offshore of Barkley Sound, ~35 km SW of Tofino/Ucluelet. Proxy for the Tofino beaches.

46146.name: Halibut Bank
46146.note: Central Strait of Georgia. Wind-sea only; used for calm-water paddling checks.

46304.name: English Bay
46304.note: Entrance to English Bay, Vancouver (Ocean Protection Plan buoy). Calm-water checks.

46087.name: Neah Bay buoy
46087.note: No station near Jordan River or Sombrio reports hourly wind, so the Neah Bay buoy's anemometer (3.8 m above the sea, ~50 km west, open ocean) stands in. Reads lighter than a 10 m mast.

1038210.name: Tofino Airport
1038210.note: Inland of Long Beach; more sheltered than the beaches, so it under-reads sea breezes.

1106200.name: Point Atkinson
1106200.note: Lighthouse at the mouth of Burrard Inlet / English Bay.

1108395.name: Vancouver Airport
1108395.note: Exposed airport anemometer on the Fraser delta: windier than False Creek, hence lenient thresholds.

07013.name: Sheringham Point
07013.note: Prediction station 6 km east of Jordan River (no Jordan River station exists).
